findings.title: Incorrect curvature coefficient changes the extension equation
findings.proof: Correct C=(n-2gamma)^2/[4n(n-1)]. Printed coefficient differs by 3(gamma^2+1)/[4n(n-1)]. The explicit complete hyperbolic 4-ball, round S^3 boundary, gamma=1/2, rho=(1-r^2)exp((1-r^2)/2)/2, f=1, U=exp((r^2-1)/2) satisfies the spectral and correct extension equations; printed residual is 15(r^2-4)exp(3(r^2-1)/2)/16.
findings.hypotheses: n=3,a=0,s=2; complete Ric=-3g, smooth round infinity, exact FG condition and boundary ratio; smooth finite-energy U; spectral gap 9/4>2. Proposition 2.13 permits smooth arbitrary f. No assertion f=1 is locally P_1-harmonic.
findings.impact: Central equivalence between curved PDE and fractional GJMS extension fails as written, including later spectral transfer.
findings.counterevidence: Flat R=0 case unchanged; many bounded-potential estimates may survive.
findings.repair_limit: Correct coefficient and recheck extension, uniqueness, frequency and boundary transfer; no claim all singular-set conclusions false or completely repaired.

findings.title: Caccioppoli estimate has incompatible amplitude powers
findings.proof: In local flat a=0,J=0 model, U=A>0,beta=4 and nonzero smooth compact cutoff give A^4 I<=C A^2 I; choose A^2>C. Linear solution scaling gives the same obstruction generally.
findings.hypotheses: Local ball energy solution and finite integrals; not a counterexample to global Schwartz/energy assumptions.
findings.impact: Displayed iteration input false; corrected test yields U^beta on right and explicit beta constants.
findings.counterevidence: No demonstrated damage to the later geometric conclusions from this local error; corrected local energy estimate supplied.
findings.repair_limit: Use correct energy test and regularization for signed U.

findings.title: Wrong sign for negative weight exponents
findings.proof: a=-1/2 (gamma=3/4), rho>0, small positive r and |O(r)|<1/2 give strictly negative derivative; flat normal derivative -1/(2r^(3/2)).
findings.hypotheses: Admitted parameter range and geometric inward ray; no solution assumption needed.
findings.counterevidence: Later inspected frequency calculations retain signed a instead of invoking nonnegativity.
findings.repair_limit: Correct sign; no established failure of almost monotonicity.

findings.title: High-order extension needs jet matching and precise smallness
findings.proof: Conditional odd-jet calculation yields plus/minus l!c_l for the two one-sided derivatives. Hypothesis prints epsilon while subsequent bound uses delta.
findings.hypotheses: No actual PE/PDE/frequency-normalized solution with a nonzero offending jet constructed; conditional polynomial is not a counterexample.
findings.impact: Core regularity step requires evidence; theorem falsity not established.
findings.counterevidence: Lemma 2.19, equations (2.42)-(2.43) on p.14, states arbitrary-order C^{k,alpha} estimates whose proof explicitly describes them as holding across the doubled boundary. The primary verifier actually viewed that page. If applicable with that two-sided regularity, evenness of U forces the relevant odd normal jets to vanish and removes the conditional jet obstruction. These assertions require reconciliation with finite smoothness in Remark 2.20 (p.15) and the high-order approximation discussion in Remark 4.21 (p.43). Their relationship has not been resolved here; no admissible counterexample has been established.
findings.repair_limit: Clarify the applicable two-sided regularity, prove matching jets and the quantitative extension bound, and state the required smallness quantifier. No confirmed failure of Proposition 4.20 or of the Hausdorff bound is asserted.

acceptance_revision.notes: Focused acceptance adds material counterevidence to existing P4 while retaining Needs Evidence. P1-P3 and their severities remain supported. Historical initial review computations are preserved without reattribution. The primary actually viewed source p.14 and checked its full-ball notation and across-boundary statement.

focused_checks.reason: Primary independently substituted a=1-2gamma and the two FG identities from pp.11-12: the coefficient is (n-2gamma)^2/[4n(n-1)], differing from the printed expression by 3(gamma^2+1)/[4n(n-1)]. In the complete hyperbolic four-ball at n=3,gamma=1/2, direct conformal radial differentiation gives Delta_bar U=(4-r^2)e^{-3phi}, R_bar U=6(4-r^2)e^{-3phi}; hence the printed coefficient 1/96 leaves the nonzero stated residual while 1/6 cancels it. The f=1 example is admissible for Proposition 2.13, which allows arbitrary smooth trace; it is not claimed locally P_gamma-harmonic. The same potential enters (4.2),(4.86),(4.92). Major reflects this failed central identification; flat R=0 and bounded-potential estimates limit the demonstrated impact. Initial exact script/output were read and their analytical scope checked, without claiming a new run.

Primary read the local energy-solution hypothesis in (2.38) and actually viewed (2.39). Constant positive local U=A with beta=4 gives A^4 I versus C A^2 I for a fixed nonzero cutoff. The report does not use that local model as a global Schwartz counterexample. The displayed corrected test estimate follows by Young's inequality with the stated beta factors. No failure of the later geometric theorem is thereby established.

Primary checked the full a in (-1,1) range, (4.9)-(4.10), and signed occurrences on pp.37-38. For a=-1/2 and positive rho, the small-r derivative is negative. Later expressions retain a rather than the false nonnegativity, so the report correctly limits the impact to this local sign claim.

Primary read pp.13-15 and 30-31,43-45 and actually viewed p.14. Lemma 2.19 uses a full doubled ball and explicitly says the arbitrary-order estimates hold across the characteristic manifold. If those estimates apply, evenness kills every relevant odd normal jet, defeating an unconditional odd-jet objection. This material counterevidence has now been included in the current report/findings. The finite-smoothness statements of Remarks 2.20 and 4.21 and the epsilon/delta mismatch require clarification, but no actual admissible PE/PDE/frequency-normalized counterexample exists in the evidence. Needs Evidence remains the honest status; no theorem failure is asserted.

independent_acceptance.scope: Independent verification of every existing reported Problem only; no claim of a new exhaustive whole-paper review.
